finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.assumptions: The code snippet provided does not involve any OS command execution. The assumption here is based on the provided code and not the actual context in which this function might be used.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the only usage of sprintf is with the format string "%d", which safely formats an integer; no format specifiers that could inject arbitrary content are present. Moreover, the code does not call any OS‑command executing function (e.g., system, exec, popen). Therefore there is no path from the input to an OS command execution, invalidating the claim of command injection.
